verdict.rationale: Ironclad exposes Records, Workflows, and Data Export APIs that could be scripted to act on many contracts/records at once, and webhooks/API access support automation-style integrations, but there is no explicit documentation of a batch/bulk endpoint or bulk-action UI feature for AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: dedicated bulk/batch API endpoints, documented rate/size limits for bulk calls, and any hands-on evidence of successful large-scale bulk operations.
